23. }

36. // ChecksConfig describes the configuration for multiple readiness checks.
37. type ChecksConfig struct {
38. 	// PeriodSeconds is how long in seconds to wait between successive checks.
39. 	PeriodSeconds float64

41. 	Checks []CheckConfig

45. type CheckConfig struct {
46. 	// Port specifies the port inside the container that the service is listening on.

1. package podman
2. 
3. import (
4. 	"context"
5. 	"fmt"
6. 	"io"
7. 	"os"
8. 	"os/exec"
9. 	"os/user"
10. 	"path"
11. 	"path/filepath"
12. 	"strconv"
13. 	"strings"
14. 	"sync"
15. 	"sync/atomic"
16. 	"syscall"
17. 	"time"
18. 
19. 	"github.com/docker/docker/api/types"
20. 	dcontainer "github.com/docker/docker/api/types/container"
21. 	"github.com/docker/docker/api/types/filters"
22. 	"github.com/docker/docker/api/types/mount"
23. 	"github.com/docker/docker/pkg/stdcopy"
24. 	"github.com/sirupsen/logrus"
25. 
26. 	"github.com/determined-ai/determined/agent/internal/container"
27. 	"github.com/determined-ai/determined/agent/internal/options"
28. 	"github.com/determined-ai/determined/agent/pkg/cruntimes"
29. 	"github.com/determined-ai/determined/agent/pkg/docker"
30. 	"github.com/determined-ai/determined/agent/pkg/events"

35. 	"github.com/determined-ai/determined/master/pkg/tasks"
36. )
37. 
38. var podmanWrapperEntrypoint = path.Join(tasks.RunDir, tasks.SingularityEntrypointWrapperScript)
39. 
40. const (
41. 	hostNetworking   = "host"
42. 	bridgeNetworking = "bridge"
43. 	envFileName      = "envfile"
44. 	archivesName     = "archives"
45. )
46. 
47. // PodmanContainer captures the state of a container.
48. type PodmanContainer struct {
49. 	PID     int            `json:"pid"`
50. 	Req     cproto.RunSpec `json:"req"`
51. 	TmpDir  string         `json:"tmp_dir"`
52. 	Proc    *os.Process    `json:"-"`
53. 	Started atomic.Bool    `json:"started"`
54. }
55. 
56. // PodmanClient implements ContainerRuntime.
57. type PodmanClient struct {
58. 	log        *logrus.Entry
59. 	opts       options.PodmanOptions
60. 	mu         sync.Mutex
61. 	wg         waitgroupx.Group
62. 	containers map[cproto.ID]*PodmanContainer
63. 	agentTmp   string
64. 	debug      bool
65. }
66. 
67. // New returns a new podman client, which launches and tracks containers.
68. func New(opts options.Options) (*PodmanClient, error) {
69. 	agentTmp, err := cruntimes.BaseTempDirName(opts.AgentID)
70. 	if err != nil {
71. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unable to compose agentTmp directory path: %w", err)
72. 	}
73. 
74. 	if err := os.RemoveAll(agentTmp); err != nil {
75. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("removing agent tmp from previous runs: %w", err)
76. 	}
77. 
78. 	if err := os.MkdirAll(agentTmp, 0o700); err != nil {
79. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("preparing agent tmp: %w", err)
80. 	}
81. 
82. 	return &PodmanClient{
83. 		log:        logrus.WithField("component", "podman"),
84. 		opts:       opts.PodmanOptions,
85. 		wg:         waitgroupx.WithContext(context.Background()),
86. 		containers: make(map[cproto.ID]*PodmanContainer),
87. 		agentTmp:   agentTmp,
88. 		debug:      opts.Debug,
89. 	}, nil
90. }
91. 
92. // Close the client, killing all running containers and removing our scratch space.
93. func (s *PodmanClient) Close() error {
94. 	s.mu.Lock()
95. 	defer s.mu.Unlock()
96. 
97. 	// Since we launch procs with exec.CommandContext under s.wg's context, this cleans them up.
98. 	s.wg.Close()
99. 
100. 	if err := os.RemoveAll(s.agentTmp); err != nil {
101. 		return fmt.Errorf("cleaning up agent tmp: %w", err)
102. 	}
103. 	return nil
104. }
105. 
106. func getPullCommand(req docker.PullImage, image string) (string, []string) {
107. 	// C.f. singularity where if req.ForcePull is set then a 'pull --force' is done.
108. 	// podman does not have this option, though it does have '--pull always' on the
109. 	// run command.
110. 	return "podman", []string{"pull", image}
111. }
112. 
113. // PullImage implements container.ContainerRuntime.
114. func (s *PodmanClient) PullImage(
115. 	ctx context.Context,
116. 	req docker.PullImage,
117. 	p events.Publisher[docker.Event],
118. ) (err error) {
119. 	return cruntimes.PullImage(ctx, req, p, &s.wg, s.log, getPullCommand)
120. }
121. 
122. // CreateContainer implements container.ContainerRuntime.
123. func (s *PodmanClient) CreateContainer(
124. 	ctx context.Context,
125. 	id cproto.ID,
126. 	req cproto.RunSpec,
127. 	p events.Publisher[docker.Event],
128. ) (string, error) {
129. 	s.mu.Lock()
130. 	defer s.mu.Unlock()
131. 
132. 	s.containers[id] = &PodmanContainer{Req: req}
133. 	return id.String(), nil
134. }
135. 
136. // RunContainer implements container.ContainerRuntime.
137. // nolint: golint,maintidx // Both contexts can't both be first / TODO refactor.
138. func (s *PodmanClient) RunContainer(
139. 	ctx context.Context,
140. 	waitCtx context.Context,
141. 	id string,
142. 	p events.Publisher[docker.Event],
143. ) (*docker.Container, error) {
144. 	s.mu.Lock()
145. 	var cont *PodmanContainer
146. 	for cID, rcont := range s.containers {
147. 		if cproto.ID(id) != cID {
148. 			continue
149. 		}
150. 		cont = rcont
151. 		break
152. 	}
153. 	s.mu.Unlock()
154. 
155. 	if cont == nil {
156. 		return nil, container.ErrMissing
157. 	}
158. 	req := cont.Req
159. 
160. 	u, err := user.Current()
161. 	if err != nil {
162. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("checking user: %w", err)
163. 	}
164. 
165. 	uidgid := fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s", u.Uid, u.Gid)
166. 	if req.ContainerConfig.User != uidgid {
167. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf(
168. 			"agent running as %s cannot launch as user %s",
169. 			uidgid, req.ContainerConfig.User,
170. 		)
171. 	}
172. 
173. 	tmpdir, err := os.MkdirTemp(s.agentTmp, fmt.Sprintf("*-%s", id))
174. 	if err != nil {
175. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("making tmp dir for archives: %w", err)
176. 	}
177. 
178. 	var args []string
179. 	args = append(args, "run")
180. 	args = append(args, "--rm")
181. 	args = append(args, "--workdir", req.ContainerConfig.WorkingDir)
182. 
183. 	// Env. variables. c.f. launcher PodmanOverSlurm.java
184. 	args = append(args, "--env", "SLURM_*")
185. 	args = append(args, "--env", "CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES")
186. 	args = append(args, "--env", "NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES")
187. 	args = append(args, "--env", "ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES")
188. 	args = append(args, "--env", "HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES")
189. 	if s.debug {
190. 		args = append(args, "--env", "DET_DEBUG=1")
191. 	}
192. 	envFilePath := path.Join(tmpdir, envFileName)
193. 	envFile, err := os.OpenFile(
194. 		envFilePath,
195. 		os.O_APPEND|os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY,
196. 		0o600,
197. 	) // #nosec G304 // We made this filepath, and it is randomized.
198. 	if err != nil {
199. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("creating envfile %s: %w", envFilePath, err)
200. 	}
201. 	args = append(args, "--env-file", envFilePath)
202. 
203. 	req.ContainerConfig.Env = append(req.ContainerConfig.Env, "DET_SHIPPER_EMIT_STDOUT_LOGS=False")
204. 
205. 	for _, env := range req.ContainerConfig.Env {
206. 		_, err = envFile.WriteString(env + "\n")
207. 		if err != nil {
208. 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("writing to envfile: %w", err)
209. 		}
210. 	}
211. 	if err = envFile.Close(); err != nil {
212. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("closing envfile: %w", err)
213. 	}
214. 
215. 	switch {
216. 	case req.HostConfig.NetworkMode == bridgeNetworking && s.opts.AllowNetworkCreation:
217. 		// ?? publish ports only for bridgeNetworking
218. 		for port := range req.ContainerConfig.ExposedPorts {
219. 			p := port.Int()
220. 			args = append(args, "-p", fmt.Sprintf("%d:%d/tcp", p, p))
221. 		}
222. 		args = append(args, "--network=bridge")
223. 	case req.HostConfig.NetworkMode == bridgeNetworking:
224. 		if err = p.Publish(ctx, docker.NewLogEvent(
225. 			model.LogLevelDebug,
226. 			"container requested network virtualization, but network creation isn't allowed; "+
227. 				"overriding to host networking",
228. 		)); err != nil {
229. 			return nil, err
230. 		}
231. 		req.HostConfig.NetworkMode = hostNetworking
232. 		fallthrough
233. 	case req.HostConfig.NetworkMode == hostNetworking:
234. 		args = append(args, "--network=host")
235. 	default:
236. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported network mode %s", req.HostConfig.NetworkMode)
237. 	}
238. 
239. 	archivesPath := filepath.Join(tmpdir, archivesName)
240. 	mountPoints, wErr := cruntimes.ArchiveMountPoints(ctx, req, p, archivesPath, s.log)
241. 	if wErr != nil {
242. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("determining mount points: %w", err)
243. 	}
244. 	for _, m := range mountPoints {
245. 		args = append(args, "--volume", fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s", path.Join(archivesPath, m), m))
246. 	}
247. 
248. 	for _, m := range req.HostConfig.Mounts {
249. 		args = hostMountsToPodmanArgs(m, args)
250. 	}
251. 
252. 	// from master task_container_defaults.shm_size_bytes
253. 	if shmsize := req.HostConfig.ShmSize; shmsize != 4294967296 { // 4294967296 is the default.
254. 		args = append(args, "--shm-size", fmt.Sprintf("%d", shmsize))
255. 	}
256. 
257. 	args = capabilitiesToPodmanArgs(req, args)
258. 
259. 	image := cruntimes.CanonicalizeImage(req.ContainerConfig.Image)
260. 	args = append(args, image)
261. 	args = append(args, podmanWrapperEntrypoint)
262. 	args = append(args, req.ContainerConfig.Cmd...)
263. 
264. 	if err = s.pprintPodmanCommand(ctx, args, p); err != nil {
265. 		return nil, err
266. 	}
267. 
268. 	// #nosec G204 // We launch arbitrary user code as a service.
269. 	cmd := exec.CommandContext(waitCtx, "podman", args...)
270. 	stdout, err := cmd.StdoutPipe()
271. 	if err != nil {
272. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("creating stdout pipe: %w", err)
273. 	}
274. 	stderr, err := cmd.StderrPipe()
275. 	if err != nil {
276. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("creating stderr pipe: %w", err)
277. 	}
278. 	s.wg.Go(func(ctx context.Context) { s.shipPodmanCmdLogs(ctx, stdout, stdcopy.Stdout, p) })
279. 	s.wg.Go(func(ctx context.Context) { s.shipPodmanCmdLogs(ctx, stderr, stdcopy.Stderr, p) })
280. 
281. 	if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
282. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("starting podman container: %w", err)
283. 	}
284. 
285. 	cont.PID = cmd.Process.Pid
286. 	cont.Proc = cmd.Process
287. 	cont.TmpDir = tmpdir
288. 	cont.Started.Store(true)
289. 	at := time.Now().String()
290. 	s.log.Infof("started container %s with pid %d", id, cont.PID)
291. 
292. 	return &docker.Container{
293. 		ContainerInfo: types.ContainerJSON{
294. 			ContainerJSONBase: &types.ContainerJSONBase{
295. 				ID:      strconv.Itoa(cont.Proc.Pid),
296. 				Created: at,
297. 				Path:    podmanWrapperEntrypoint,
298. 				Args:    req.ContainerConfig.Cmd,
299. 				State: &types.ContainerState{
300. 					Status:    "running",
301. 					Running:   true,
302. 					Pid:       cont.Proc.Pid,
303. 					StartedAt: at,
304. 				},
305. 				Image: image,
306. 				HostConfig: &dcontainer.HostConfig{
307. 					NetworkMode: req.HostConfig.NetworkMode,
308. 				},
309. 			},
310. 			Config: &dcontainer.Config{
311. 				ExposedPorts: req.ContainerConfig.ExposedPorts,
312. 			},
313. 		},
314. 		ContainerWaiter: s.waitOnContainer(cproto.ID(id), cont, p),
315. 	}, nil
316. }

318. func capabilitiesToPodmanArgs(req cproto.RunSpec, args []string) []string {
319. 	for _, cap := range req.HostConfig.CapAdd {
320. 		args = append(args, "--cap-add", cap)
321. 	}
322. 	for _, cap := range req.HostConfig.CapDrop {
323. 		args = append(args, "--cap-drop", cap)
324. 	}
325. 	return args
326. }

328. func hostMountsToPodmanArgs(m mount.Mount, args []string) []string {
329. 	var mountOptions []string
330. 	if m.ReadOnly {
331. 		mountOptions = append(mountOptions, "ro")
332. 	}
333. 	if m.BindOptions != nil && string(m.BindOptions.Propagation) != "" {
334. 		mountOptions = append(mountOptions, string(m.BindOptions.Propagation))
335. 	}
336. 	var options string
337. 	if len(mountOptions) > 0 {
338. 		options = fmt.Sprintf(":%s", strings.Join(mountOptions, ","))
339. 	}
340. 	return append(args, "--volume", fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s%s", m.Source, m.Target, options))
341. }

406. func (s *PodmanClient) waitOnContainer(
407. 	id cproto.ID,
408. 	cont *PodmanContainer,
409. 	p events.Publisher[docker.Event],
410. ) docker.ContainerWaiter {
411. 	wchan := make(chan dcontainer.ContainerWaitOKBody, 1)
412. 	errchan := make(chan error)
413. 	s.wg.Go(func(ctx context.Context) {
414. 		defer close(wchan)
415. 		defer close(errchan)
416. 
417. 		var body dcontainer.ContainerWaitOKBody
418. 		switch state, err := cont.Proc.Wait(); {
419. 		case ctx.Err() != nil && err == nil && state.ExitCode() == -1:
420. 			s.log.Trace("detached from container process")
421. 			return
422. 		case err != nil:
423. 			s.log.Tracef("proc %d for container %s exited: %s", cont.PID, id, err)
424. 			body.Error = &dcontainer.ContainerWaitOKBodyError{Message: err.Error()}
425. 		default:
426. 			s.log.Tracef("proc %d for container %s exited with %d", cont.PID, id, state.ExitCode())
427. 			body.StatusCode = int64(state.ExitCode())
428. 		}
429. 
430. 		select {
431. 		case wchan <- body:
432. 		case <-ctx.Done():
433. 			return
434. 		}
435. 
436. 		s.mu.Lock()
437. 		defer s.mu.Unlock()
438. 		s.log.Tracef("forgetting completed container: %s", id)
439. 		delete(s.containers, id)
440. 
441. 		// Defer file cleanup until restart if debug logging is enabled.
442. 		if s.log.Logger.Level <= logrus.DebugLevel {
443. 			if err := p.Publish(ctx, docker.NewLogEvent(
444. 				model.LogLevelDebug,
445. 				fmt.Sprintf("leaving tmpdir %s for inspection", cont.TmpDir),
446. 			)); err != nil {
447. 				return
448. 			}
449. 		} else {
450. 			if err := os.RemoveAll(cont.TmpDir); err != nil {
451. 				if err = p.Publish(ctx, docker.NewLogEvent(
452. 					model.LogLevelWarning,
453. 					fmt.Sprintf("failed to cleanup tmpdir (ephemeral mounts, etc): %s", err),
454. 				)); err != nil {
455. 					logrus.WithError(err).Error("publishing cleanup failure warning")
456. 					return
457. 				}
458. 			}
459. 		}
460. 	})
461. 	return docker.ContainerWaiter{Waiter: wchan, Errs: errchan}
462. }

48. // SingularityContainer captures the state of a container.
49. type SingularityContainer struct {
50. 	PID     int            `json:"pid"`
51. 	Req     cproto.RunSpec `json:"req"`
52. 	TmpDir  string         `json:"tmp_dir"`
53. 	Proc    *os.Process    `json:"-"`

57. // SingularityClient implements ContainerRuntime.
58. type SingularityClient struct {
59. 	log         *logrus.Entry
60. 	opts        options.SingularityOptions
61. 	mu          sync.Mutex
62. 	wg          waitgroupx.Group
63. 	containers  map[cproto.ID]*SingularityContainer
64. 	agentTmp    string
65. 	debug       bool
66. 	isApptainer bool
67. 	imageRoot   string // optional path name to root of image cache
68. }

70. // New returns a new singularity client, which launches and tracks containers.
71. func New(opts options.Options) (*SingularityClient, error) {
72. 	agentTmp, err := cruntimes.BaseTempDirName(opts.AgentID)
73. 	if err != nil {
74. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unable to compose agentTmp directory path: %w", err)
75. 	}
76. 
77. 	if err := os.RemoveAll(agentTmp); err != nil {
78. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("removing agent tmp from previous runs: %w", err)
79. 	}
80. 
81. 	if err := os.MkdirAll(agentTmp, 0o700); err != nil {
82. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("preparing agent tmp: %w", err)
83. 	}
84. 
85. 	// Validate image root (if provided)
86. 	if opts.ImageRoot != "" {
87. 		if _, err := os.ReadDir(opts.ImageRoot); err != nil {
88. 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("reading image root directory: %w", err)
89. 		}
90. 	}
91. 
92. 	return &SingularityClient{
93. 		log:         logrus.WithField("component", "singularity"),
94. 		opts:        opts.SingularityOptions,
95. 		wg:          waitgroupx.WithContext(context.Background()),
96. 		containers:  make(map[cproto.ID]*SingularityContainer),
97. 		agentTmp:    agentTmp,
98. 		debug:       opts.Debug,
99. 		isApptainer: opts.ContainerRuntime == options.ApptainerContainerRuntime,
100. 		imageRoot:   opts.ImageRoot,
101. 	}, nil
102. }

104. // Close the client, killing all running containers and removing our scratch space.
105. func (s *SingularityClient) Close() error {
106. 	s.mu.Lock()
107. 	defer s.mu.Unlock()
108. 
109. 	// Since we launch procs with exec.CommandContext under s.wg's context, this cleans them up.
110. 	s.wg.Close()
111. 
112. 	if err := os.RemoveAll(s.agentTmp); err != nil {
113. 		return fmt.Errorf("cleaning up agent tmp: %w", err)
114. 	}
115. 	return nil
116. }

142. // RunContainer implements container.ContainerRuntime.
143. // nolint: golint,maintidx // Both contexts can't both be first / TODO refactor.
144. func (s *SingularityClient) RunContainer(
145. 	ctx context.Context,
146. 	waitCtx context.Context,
147. 	id string,
148. 	p events.Publisher[docker.Event],
149. ) (*docker.Container, error) {
150. 	s.mu.Lock()
151. 	var cont *SingularityContainer
152. 	for cID, rcont := range s.containers {
153. 		if cproto.ID(id) != cID {
154. 			continue
155. 		}
156. 		cont = rcont
157. 		break
158. 	}
159. 	s.mu.Unlock()
160. 
161. 	if cont == nil {
162. 		return nil, container.ErrMissing
163. 	}
164. 	req := cont.Req
165. 
166. 	u, err := user.Current()
167. 	if err != nil {
168. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("checking user: %w", err)
169. 	}
170. 
171. 	uidgid := fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s", u.Uid, u.Gid)
172. 	if req.ContainerConfig.User != uidgid {
173. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf(
174. 			"agent running as %s cannot launch as user %s",
175. 			uidgid, req.ContainerConfig.User,
176. 		)
177. 	}
178. 
179. 	tmpdir, err := os.MkdirTemp(s.agentTmp, fmt.Sprintf("*-%s", id))
180. 	if err != nil {
181. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("making tmp dir for archives: %w", err)
182. 	}
183. 
184. 	var args []string
185. 	args = append(args, "run")
186. 	args = append(args, "--writable-tmpfs")
187. 	args = append(args, "--pwd", req.ContainerConfig.WorkingDir)
188. 
189. 	envFilePath := path.Join(tmpdir, envFileName)
190. 	envFile, err := os.OpenFile(
191. 		envFilePath,
192. 		os.O_APPEND|os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY,
193. 		0o600,
194. 	) // #nosec G304 // We made this filepath, and it is randomized.
195. 	if err != nil {
196. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("creating envfile %s: %w", envFilePath, err)
197. 	}
198. 	args = append(args, "--env-file", envFilePath)
199. 
200. 	req.ContainerConfig.Env = append(req.ContainerConfig.Env, "DET_SHIPPER_EMIT_STDOUT_LOGS=False")
201. 
202. 	var b64EnvVars []string
203. 	for _, env := range req.ContainerConfig.Env {
204. 		parts := strings.SplitN(env, "=", 2)
205. 
206. 		var formattedEnv string
207. 		switch len(parts) {
208. 		case 0:
209. 			continue // Must be empty envvar.
210. 		case 1:
211. 			formattedEnv = fmt.Sprintf("%s=", env)
212. 		case 2:
213. 			// Don't even attempt to escape quotes, strconv.Quote doesn't work - singularity seems
214. 			// to unescape it multiple times.
215. 			if strings.Contains(parts[1], "\"") {
216. 				b64EnvVars = append(b64EnvVars, parts[0])
217. 				formattedEnv = fmt.Sprintf(
218. 					"%s=\"%s\"",
219. 					parts[0], base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(parts[1])),
220. 				)
221. 			} else {
222. 				formattedEnv = fmt.Sprintf("%s=%s", parts[0], strconv.Quote(parts[1]))
223. 			}
224. 		}
225. 
226. 		_, err = envFile.WriteString(formattedEnv + "\n")
227. 		if err != nil {
228. 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("writing to envfile: %w", err)
229. 		}
230. 	}
231. 
232. 	_, err = envFile.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf(
233. 		"DET_B64_ENCODED_ENVVARS=%s\n",
234. 		strings.Join(b64EnvVars, ","),
235. 	))
236. 	if err != nil {
237. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("writing to envfile: %w", err)
238. 	}
239. 	detDebug := 0
240. 	if s.debug {
241. 		detDebug = 1
242. 	}
243. 	if _, err = envFile.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("DET_DEBUG=%d\n", detDebug)); err != nil {
244. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("writing to envfile: %w", err)
245. 	}
246. 	if err = envFile.Close(); err != nil {
247. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("closing envfile: %w", err)
248. 	}
249. 	switch {
250. 	case req.HostConfig.NetworkMode == bridgeNetworking && s.opts.AllowNetworkCreation:
251. 		// --net sets up a bridge network by default
252. 		// (see https://apptainer.org/user-docs/3.0/networking.html#net)
253. 		args = append(args, "--net")
254. 		// Do the equivalent of Docker's PublishAllPorts = true
255. 		for port := range req.ContainerConfig.ExposedPorts {
256. 			p := port.Int()
257. 			args = append(args, "--network-args", fmt.Sprintf("portmap=%d:%d/tcp", p, p))
258. 		}
259. 	case req.HostConfig.NetworkMode == bridgeNetworking:
260. 		if err = p.Publish(ctx, docker.NewLogEvent(
261. 			model.LogLevelDebug,
262. 			"container requested network virtualization, but network creation isn't allowed; "+
263. 				"overriding to host networking",
264. 		)); err != nil {
265. 			return nil, err
266. 		}
267. 		req.HostConfig.NetworkMode = hostNetworking
268. 		fallthrough
269. 	case req.HostConfig.NetworkMode == hostNetworking:
270. 	default:
271. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported network mode %s", req.HostConfig.NetworkMode)
272. 	}
273. 
274. 	archivesPath := filepath.Join(tmpdir, archivesName)
275. 	mountPoints, wErr := cruntimes.ArchiveMountPoints(ctx, req, p, archivesPath, s.log)
276. 	if wErr != nil {
277. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("determining mount points: %w", err)
278. 	}
279. 	for _, m := range mountPoints {
280. 		args = append(args, "--bind", fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s", path.Join(archivesPath, m), m))
281. 	}
282. 
283. 	for _, m := range req.HostConfig.Mounts {
284. 		if m.BindOptions != nil && m.BindOptions.Propagation != "rprivate" { // rprivate is default.
285. 			if err = p.Publish(ctx, docker.NewLogEvent(model.LogLevelWarning, fmt.Sprintf(
286. 				"mount %s:%s had propagation settings but singularity does not support this; "+
287. 					"will bind mount anyway, without them",
288. 				m.Source, m.Target,
289. 			))); err != nil {
290. 				return nil, err
291. 			}
292. 		}
293. 		bindMountTemplate := "%s:%s"
294. 		if m.ReadOnly {
295. 			bindMountTemplate += ":ro"
296. 		}
297. 		args = append(args, "--bind", fmt.Sprintf(bindMountTemplate, m.Source, m.Target))
298. 	}
299. 
300. 	if shmsize := req.HostConfig.ShmSize; shmsize != 4294967296 { // 4294967296 is the default.
301. 		if err = p.Publish(ctx, docker.NewLogEvent(model.LogLevelWarning, fmt.Sprintf(
302. 			"shmsize was requested as %d but singularity does not support this; "+
303. 				"we do not launch with `--contain`, so we inherit the configuration of the host",
304. 			shmsize,
305. 		))); err != nil {
306. 			return nil, err
307. 		}
308. 	}
309. 
310. 	s.log.Tracef("Device type is %s", req.DeviceType)
311. 	if req.DeviceType == device.ROCM {
312. 		args = append(args, "--rocm")
313. 	}
314. 
315. 	// Visible devices are set later by modifying the exec.Command's env.
316. 	var cudaVisibleDevices []string
317. 	for _, d := range cont.Req.HostConfig.DeviceRequests {
318. 		if d.Driver == "nvidia" {
319. 			cudaVisibleDevices = append(cudaVisibleDevices, d.DeviceIDs...)
320. 		}
321. 	}
322. 	if len(cudaVisibleDevices) > 0 {
323. 		args = append(args, "--nv", "--nvccli", "--contain")
324. 		if s.isApptainer {
325. 			// Using --userns to avoid this error when using --nvccli:
326. 			// FATAL:   nvidia-container-cli not allowed in setuid mode
327. 			// (e.g.: casablanca, apptainer version 1.2.2-1)
328. 			args = append(args, "--userns")
329. 		}
330. 	}
331. 
332. 	args = capabilitiesToSingularityArgs(req, args)
333. 	image := s.computeImageReference(req.ContainerConfig.Image)
334. 	args = append(args, image)
335. 	args = append(args, singularityWrapperEntrypoint)
336. 	args = append(args, req.ContainerConfig.Cmd...)
337. 
338. 	if err = s.pprintSingularityCommand(ctx, args, p); err != nil {
339. 		return nil, err
340. 	}
341. 
342. 	// #nosec G204 // We launch arbitrary user code as a service.
343. 	cmd := exec.CommandContext(waitCtx, "singularity", args...)
344. 	stdout, err := cmd.StdoutPipe()
345. 	if err != nil {
346. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("creating stdout pipe: %w", err)
347. 	}
348. 	stderr, err := cmd.StderrPipe()
349. 	if err != nil {
350. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("creating stderr pipe: %w", err)
351. 	}
352. 	s.wg.Go(func(ctx context.Context) { s.shipSingularityCmdLogs(ctx, stdout, stdcopy.Stdout, p) })
353. 	s.wg.Go(func(ctx context.Context) { s.shipSingularityCmdLogs(ctx, stderr, stdcopy.Stderr, p) })
354. 
355. 	s.setCommandEnvironment(req, cudaVisibleDevices, cmd)
356. 
357. 	if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
358. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("starting singularity container: %w", err)
359. 	}
360. 
361. 	cont.PID = cmd.Process.Pid
362. 	cont.Proc = cmd.Process
363. 	cont.TmpDir = tmpdir
364. 	cont.Started.Store(true)
365. 	at := time.Now().String()
366. 	s.log.Infof("started container %s with pid %d", id, cont.PID)
367. 
368. 	return &docker.Container{
369. 		ContainerInfo: types.ContainerJSON{
370. 			ContainerJSONBase: &types.ContainerJSONBase{
371. 				ID:      strconv.Itoa(cont.Proc.Pid),
372. 				Created: at,
373. 				Path:    singularityWrapperEntrypoint,
374. 				Args:    req.ContainerConfig.Cmd,
375. 				State: &types.ContainerState{
376. 					Status:    "running",
377. 					Running:   true,
378. 					Pid:       cont.Proc.Pid,
379. 					StartedAt: at,
380. 				},
381. 				Image: image,
382. 				HostConfig: &dcontainer.HostConfig{
383. 					NetworkMode: req.HostConfig.NetworkMode,
384. 				},
385. 			},
386. 			Config: &dcontainer.Config{
387. 				ExposedPorts: req.ContainerConfig.ExposedPorts,
388. 			},
389. 		},
390. 		ContainerWaiter: s.waitOnContainer(cproto.ID(id), cont, p),
391. 	}, nil
392. }
393. 
394. // computeImageReference computes a reference to the requested image. If an image cache
395. // directory is defined and it contains the required image, a path name to the cached image
396. // will be returned, else a docker reference so that the image can be downloaded.
397. func (s *SingularityClient) computeImageReference(requestedImage string) string {
398. 	s.log.Tracef("requested image: %s", requestedImage)
399. 	if s.imageRoot != "" {
400. 		cachePathName := s.imageRoot + "/" + requestedImage
401. 		if _, err := os.Stat(cachePathName); err != nil {
402. 			s.log.Tracef("image is not in cache: %s", err.Error())
403. 		} else {
404. 			return cachePathName
405. 		}
406. 	}
407. 	return cruntimes.CanonicalizeImage(requestedImage)
408. }
409. 
410. // Sets the environment of the process that will run the Singularity/apptainer command.
411. func (s *SingularityClient) setCommandEnvironment(
412. 	req cproto.RunSpec, cudaVisibleDevices []string, cmd *exec.Cmd,
413. ) {
414. 	// Per https://pkg.go.dev/os/exec#Cmd.Env, if cmd.Env is nil, the new process uses the current
415. 	// process's environment. If this is not the case, for example because we specify something to
416. 	// control Singularity operation, then we need to explicitly specify any value needed from the
417. 	// current environment.
418. 	if req.DeviceType == device.CUDA {
419. 		cudaVisibleDevicesVar := strings.Join(cudaVisibleDevices, ",")
420. 
421. 		// NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES together with options on the singularity/apptainer run
422. 		// command control the visibility of the GPUs in the container.
423. 		visibleDevices := fmt.Sprintf("NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=%s", cudaVisibleDevicesVar)
424. 		s.log.Trace(visibleDevices)
425. 		cmd.Env = append(cmd.Env, visibleDevices)
426. 	}
427. 	if req.DeviceType == device.ROCM {
428. 		// Avoid this problem: https://github.com/determined-ai/determined-ee/pull/922
429. 		// by not setting both ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES & CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
430. 		s.addToTargetCommandEnvironmentIfSet(cmd, "ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES")
431. 	}
432. 
433. 	s.addOptionalRegistryAuthCredentials(req, cmd)
434. 
435. 	// HACK(singularity): without this, --nv doesn't work right. If the singularity run command
436. 	// cannot find nvidia-smi, the --nv fails to make it available inside the container, e.g.,
437. 	// env -i /usr/bin/singularity run --nv \\
438. 	//   docker://determinedai/environments:cuda-11.3-pytorch-1.10-tf-2.8-gpu-24586f0 nvidia-smi
439. 	cmd.Env = append(cmd.Env, fmt.Sprintf("PATH=%s", os.Getenv("PATH")))
440. 
441. 	s.addToTargetCommandEnvironmentIfSet(cmd, "http_proxy")
442. 	s.addToTargetCommandEnvironmentIfSet(cmd, "https_proxy")
443. 	s.addToTargetCommandEnvironmentIfSet(cmd, "no_proxy")
444. 	s.addToTargetCommandEnvironmentIfSet(cmd, "APPTAINER_CACHEDIR")
445. 	s.addToTargetCommandEnvironmentIfSet(cmd, "SINGULARITY_CACHEDIR")
446. }
447. 
448. // addToTargetCommandEnvironmentIfSet adds to the target command environment the value of
449. // the specified environment variable from the current process, if set.
450. func (s *SingularityClient) addToTargetCommandEnvironmentIfSet(cmd *exec.Cmd, variable string) {
451. 	if value, present := os.LookupEnv(variable); present {
452. 		s.log.Debugf("Forwarding %s=%s", variable, value)
453. 		cmd.Env = append(cmd.Env, fmt.Sprintf("%s=%s", variable, value))
454. 	}
455. }
456. 
457. func (s *SingularityClient) addOptionalRegistryAuthCredentials(req cproto.RunSpec, cmd *exec.Cmd) {
458. 	s.log.Trace("Checking for supplied credentials")
459. 	if req.Registry != nil {
460. 		cmd.Env = append(cmd.Env,
461. 			fmt.Sprintf("SINGULARITY_DOCKER_USERNAME=%s", req.Registry.Username),
462. 			fmt.Sprintf("SINGULARITY_DOCKER_PASSWORD=%s", req.Registry.Password),
463. 			fmt.Sprintf("APPTAINER_DOCKER_USERNAME=%s", req.Registry.Username),
464. 			fmt.Sprintf("APPTAINER_DOCKER_PASSWORD=%s", req.Registry.Password))
465. 	}
466. }
467. 
468. func capabilitiesToSingularityArgs(req cproto.RunSpec, args []string) []string {
469. 	if len(req.HostConfig.CapAdd) > 0 {
470. 		args = append(args, "--add-caps", strings.Join(req.HostConfig.CapAdd, ","))
471. 	}
472. 	if len(req.HostConfig.CapDrop) > 0 {
473. 		args = append(args, "--drop-caps", strings.Join(req.HostConfig.CapDrop, ","))
474. 	}
475. 	return args
476. }

478. // ReattachContainer implements container.ContainerRuntime.
479. // TODO(DET-9082): Ensure orphaned processes are cleaned up on reattach.
480. func (s *SingularityClient) ReattachContainer(
481. 	ctx context.Context,
482. 	reattachID cproto.ID,
483. ) (*docker.Container, *aproto.ExitCode, error) {
484. 	return nil, nil, container.ErrMissing
485. }
486. 
487. // RemoveContainer implements container.ContainerRuntime.
488. func (s *SingularityClient) RemoveContainer(ctx context.Context, id string, force bool) error {
489. 	s.mu.Lock()
490. 	defer s.mu.Unlock()
491. 
492. 	cont, ok := s.containers[cproto.ID(id)]
493. 	if !ok {
494. 		return container.ErrMissing
495. 	}
496. 
497. 	if cont.Started.Load() {
498. 		return cont.Proc.Kill()
499. 	}
500. 	return fmt.Errorf("cannot kill container %s that is not started", id)
501. }
502. 
503. // SignalContainer implements container.ContainerRuntime.
504. func (s *SingularityClient) SignalContainer(
505. 	ctx context.Context,
506. 	id string,
507. 	sig syscall.Signal,
508. ) error {
509. 	s.mu.Lock()
510. 	defer s.mu.Unlock()
511. 
512. 	cont, ok := s.containers[cproto.ID(id)]
513. 	if !ok {
514. 		return container.ErrMissing
515. 	}
516. 
517. 	if cont.Started.Load() {
518. 		return cont.Proc.Signal(sig)
519. 	}
520. 	return fmt.Errorf("cannot signal container %s with %s that is not started", id, sig)
521. }
522. 
523. // ListRunningContainers implements container.ContainerRuntime.
524. func (s *SingularityClient) ListRunningContainers(
525. 	ctx context.Context,
526. 	fs filters.Args,
527. ) (map[cproto.ID]types.Container, error) {
528. 	resp := make(map[cproto.ID]types.Container)
529. 
530. 	s.mu.Lock()
531. 	defer s.mu.Unlock()
532. 	for id, cont := range s.containers {
533. 		resp[id] = types.Container{
534. 			ID:     string(id),
535. 			Labels: cont.Req.ContainerConfig.Labels,
536. 		}
537. 	}
538. 	return resp, nil
539. }
540. 
541. func (s *SingularityClient) waitOnContainer(
542. 	id cproto.ID,
543. 	cont *SingularityContainer,
544. 	p events.Publisher[docker.Event],
545. ) docker.ContainerWaiter {
546. 	wchan := make(chan dcontainer.ContainerWaitOKBody, 1)
547. 	errchan := make(chan error)
548. 	s.wg.Go(func(ctx context.Context) {
549. 		defer close(wchan)
550. 		defer close(errchan)
551. 
552. 		var body dcontainer.ContainerWaitOKBody
553. 		switch state, err := cont.Proc.Wait(); {
554. 		case ctx.Err() != nil && err == nil && state.ExitCode() == -1:
555. 			s.log.Trace("detached from container process")
556. 			return
557. 		case err != nil:
558. 			s.log.Tracef("proc %d for container %s exited: %s", cont.PID, id, err)
559. 			body.Error = &dcontainer.ContainerWaitOKBodyError{Message: err.Error()}
560. 		default:
561. 			s.log.Tracef("proc %d for container %s exited with %d", cont.PID, id, state.ExitCode())
562. 			body.StatusCode = int64(state.ExitCode())
563. 		}
564. 
565. 		select {
566. 		case wchan <- body:
567. 		case <-ctx.Done():
568. 			return
569. 		}
570. 
571. 		s.mu.Lock()
572. 		defer s.mu.Unlock()
573. 		s.log.Tracef("forgetting completed container: %s", id)
574. 		delete(s.containers, id)
575. 
576. 		// Defer file cleanup until restart if debug logging is enabled.
577. 		if s.log.Logger.Level <= logrus.DebugLevel {
578. 			if err := p.Publish(ctx, docker.NewLogEvent(
579. 				model.LogLevelDebug,
580. 				fmt.Sprintf("leaving tmpdir %s for inspection", cont.TmpDir),
581. 			)); err != nil {
582. 				return
583. 			}
584. 		} else {
585. 			if err := os.RemoveAll(cont.TmpDir); err != nil {
586. 				if err = p.Publish(ctx, docker.NewLogEvent(
587. 					model.LogLevelWarning,
588. 					fmt.Sprintf("failed to cleanup tmpdir (ephemeral mounts, etc): %s", err),
589. 				)); err != nil {
590. 					logrus.WithError(err).Error("publishing cleanup failure warning")
591. 					return
592. 				}
593. 			}
594. 		}
595. 	})
596. 	return docker.ContainerWaiter{Waiter: wchan, Errs: errchan}
597. }
598. 
599. func (s *SingularityClient) shipSingularityCmdLogs(
600. 	ctx context.Context,
601. 	r io.ReadCloser,
602. 	stdtype stdcopy.StdType,
603. 	p events.Publisher[docker.Event],
604. ) {
605. 	cruntimes.ShipContainerCommandLogs(ctx, r, stdtype, p)
606. }
607. 
608. func (s *SingularityClient) pprintSingularityCommand(
609. 	ctx context.Context,
610. 	args []string,
611. 	p events.Publisher[docker.Event],
612. ) error {
613. 	return cruntimes.PprintCommand(ctx, "singularity", args, p, s.log)
614. }

26. 	for inst, t1 := range left {
27. 		if t2, ok := right[inst]; ok {
28. 			if !t1.Add(-timeErrorTolerance).Before(t2) && t1.Add(timeErrorTolerance).After(t2) {
29. 				t.Errorf("=== DIFF %s\n-: %v\n+: %v", inst, t1, t2)
30. 				debug.PrintStack()
31. 			}
32. 		} else {
33. 			t.Errorf("=== DIFF %s\n-: %v\n+: <non-existent>", inst, t1)
34. 			debug.PrintStack()
35. 		}
36. 	}
37. 	for inst := range right {
38. 		if t1, ok := left[inst]; !ok {
39. 			t.Errorf("=== DIFF %s\n-: <non-existent>\n+: %v", inst, t1)
40. 			debug.PrintStack()
41. 		}
42. 	}
43. }
